Gli consentiamo di sfruttare i dati, le analisi, le piattaforme avanzate e le tecnologie di data science & AI per scoprire le relazioni nascoste in grandi quantità di dati, generare intuizioni e supportare il loro processo decisionale. Location: Zurich, Geneva Working Patterns: 80-100% Help our customers navigate the future with confidence and make decisions with clear data-driven choices Deloitte AI & Data helps customers harness the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centred solutions that catalyze growth and efficiency. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, advanced platforms and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships in large amounts of data, generate insights and support their decision-making. We help our customers build state-of-the-art data landscapes to take their analytics capabilities to the next level. Our mission is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to deliver results that drive their business forward. This role is open to candidates with either an AI/Analytics or Data Engineering/Data Platform background and preference. During the interview process, we will determine your affiliation within one of these specialized sub-teams. We also welcome applications from trainee candidates with limited professional experience, provided they are available for full-time work (not returning to study). After 4-6 months in a trainee role, we will reevaluate readiness for a business analyst role. For this role, we currently offer start dates from February 2026. How You Can Make a Difference
• Design and implement data strategies and advanced data solutions—including data management, platforms, and AI use cases—that enable customers to achieve their business goals in compliance, cost reduction, and revenue growth.
• Provide architectural, technical and organizational expertise to guide complex data and analysis transformations with significant organizational impact.
• Drive data & AI use cases from conception to production.
• Build trusting customer relationships through project execution and business development and expand your network internally and externally.
• Support business development opportunities to generate new projects.
• Be a role model for colleagues through strong work ethic, leadership skills and expertise.
• Continuously expand your knowledge across industries and share insights with colleagues. Who we are looking for drive and motivation:
• Passionate people who want to build a career in AI & Data Consulting.
• Strong drive to learn, master new topics and independently manage multiple activities in a fast-paced environment. Advisory and communication skills:
• Strong Microsoft PowerPoint capabilities: Ability to design and design meaningful presentations.
• Strong conceptual ability: Ability to consolidate diverse requirements into coherent solution designs and simplify complex problems.
• Business IT translators: Ability to act as a bridge between business requirements and technical solutions.
• Detail-oriented and ability to communicate technical specificities clearly in written and oral form. Technical expertise:
• First practical experience with data management, data platforms or AI & Analytics solutions is highly recommended.
• Familiarity with SQL and Python is a plus.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, including working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and related services, is a plus.
• Knowledge of data platform tools (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku) and data visualization tools (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau) are a plus.
• A strong engineering or mathematics background is beneficial. Language competence:
• Fluent in English and German to facilitate communication with different teams and stakeholders. Industry experience:
• First relevant experience in consulting, technology companies or industry-specific roles, especially in AI & data-driven areas.
• Previous experience in the banking, insurance, life science or healthcare sector is beneficial. Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 50+ highly motivated colleagues in our offices in Zurich, Geneva or Basel. We specialize in AI and data – how it can be structured, procured, transformed, stored and used. Become part of our dynamic and entertaining team and work with highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuously available learning opportunities. Deloitte AI & Data is the leading Data & Analytics Consulting team in Switzerland.
